title: A-RAG: Scaling Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Hierarchical Retrieval Interfaces
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework (A-RAG). It evaluates the system on common NLP benchmarks like HotpotQA and MuSiQue. While it contains a brief 'Ethical Considerations' section, it does not involve the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
